packageRules.description: Pspsps.Analyzers loads into the SDK's compiler, so Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp stays at the oldest .NET 10 SDK's Roslyn (5.0): a newer one is skipped with CS9057
SonarAnalyzer.CSharp gets its own PR: analyzers/sonar-*.globalconfig name the version they were made for and must be regenerated with it (bash .github/scripts/sonar-rules.sh, from the repo root)
Stay on .NET 10 (LTS) until the Npgsql EF Core provider supports the next one.
